text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, there are no seats open...

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
Your Highness.
It appears there is a slight change to the afternoon schedule.
I shall inform you of the details later.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I will check it after lunch, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
The seat next to Fine-san is still open...?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Fine-san, may I sit next to—wahyaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Doto-chan, look out—!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh? I didn't fall...?
How come—

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
—Are you uninjured?
The hamburger steak set meal is safe and sound, as you can see.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eeeek?! Fine-san's SP?! I-I'm s-s-so s-sorry! For my clumsiness to get even Fine-san wrapped up in this...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm completely fine!
The Captain shielded me properly, after all.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank goodness... I'm really sorry.
I-I should repay you somehow...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh right, I'll go get water! Fine-san's share too—wawaah!

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
Are you alright?
We will fetch the water, so please.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uuu, I'm so sorry for making more work for you~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Aah, I caused trouble again... Clumsy, useless, totally hopeless, always doing unnecessary things... uuu...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...B-But... I hate just leaving it at causing trouble...
I'll do my best to repay them...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: At least by helping out with training... so I can be of use to Fine-san...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fine-san, good work out there!
Here, please have a sports drink!

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
Please wait.
Is that not a carbonated soda rather than a sports drink—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hieeek!!
Whyyyy~?!

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
Your Highness, please step back.
Doto-sama, hand the bottle over here.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuu, I messed up again...
Why am I so completely hopeless...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(But if it stays like this, I'll have just caused trouble for Fine-san and the others...
At least let there be something I can do...!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's it...
Could I accompany you in your training?
I'll pace-run with you for as long as you like!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If so, I'd love to take you up on that.
Let's do some distance running together.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(Fine-san really is so kind...
Treating someone like me with a warm smile—)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(I want to live up to it too.
Even if I'm hopeless, with everything I've got...!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Doto-chan is full of spirit...!
Fufu, well then, I won't lose either...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I visited the training grounds,
Fine Motion and Meisho Doto
were running side-by-side in training.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*...
I intended to just run lightly,
but I ended up putting quite a bit of power into it.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Aah, I-I'm so sorry!
I caused trouble again without thinking of the pace...!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No, don't worry about it.
In fact, I'd like to thank you.
It was great motivation.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eh... Fine-san, to me?

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
It is just as Her Highness says.
Watching your inner strength, Doto-sama,
even I felt a burning passion.

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times you stumble, you keep putting in effort.
That unyielding spirit is something we of the SP squad
should engrave into our hearts as well.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hauu! That's too much praise, but...
Th-Thank... you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I can still keep giving it my all!
I look forward to working with yoush!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two continued their training together after that.
Meisho Doto's expression was noticeably
brighter than usual...
